entries.summary: Evolver documents a GEP-based agent prompt-generation engine that reads local experience signals, selects reusable Genes or Capsules and emits prompts with an audit trail. Its README distinguishes standalone prompt generation from actions performed by a host runtime.
entries.selection_context: Evaluate the documented prompt-governance and experience-reuse workflow, including review mode and the optional EvoMap network connection.
entries.limitations: Review access to project logs, hooks and any optional network sharing or worker tasks. The README announces a future transition to source-available releases and says core engine modules are obfuscated; verify the exact release and applicable license. Security, improvement claims and runtime behavior were not independently tested.
entries.decision: Retain the published route as a dated unranked reference when absent from the current discovery snapshot.
